references.text: The parallel list of unclean birds in Leviticus also includes the pelican (qa'at), stork, and heron, which correspond to the same birds mentioned in the Deuteronomy text.
Isaiah mentions the pelican (qa'at) as one of the birds that will dwell in the desolate land, linking it to its status as an unclean bird in the law.
Zephaniah also mentions the pelican (qa'at) in connection with destruction and desolate places, reflecting its role in the purity laws.
